issues: Helvetica/Arial 回退字体，大标题字距松散
悬空元素的同形软影太实，读作一份重叠的字（ClickUp 下方出现第二个 ClickUp）
速度重影只有两层离散拷贝，快速段看起来像双影故障
主区三块白色圆角砖是空白块
右段白页与主区之间是一条生硬色块分界；远端没有景深层次
changes: 字体换系统栈，大字负字距（-0.035em）、全大写小字正字距
同形软影 blur 9+h·0.13、不透明度 ≤0.26、压成无字形冷灰——读作影子
重影改三层 f-1.6/-3.2/-4.8、权重递减，叠出连续拖影（镜头常数、滑移曲线、贴落节拍不动）
三块白砖填入克制小组件（Sprint 进度 / 本周待办 / 走势线），带发丝边与两层阴影
右段白页加发丝边 + 左投影分层；屏幕空间左侧景深雾 + 颗粒；补导出 STEEP_TILT_GLIDE_DURATION=120
issuesEn: Helvetica/Arial fallback fonts with loose tracking on the big titles
Floating elements' shadows were too solid and read as duplicate text (a second 'ClickUp' under the first)
The speed ghost was only two discrete copies, which looked like a double-image glitch in fast stretches
Three white rounded tiles in the main area were empty blocks
A hard color seam between the right white page and the main area, and no depth falloff at the far end
changesEn: System font stack, tight tracking on big type (-0.035em), opened tracking on small caps
Shadows use blur 9+h·0.13, opacity ≤0.26 and are desaturated so glyphs don't read; they now look like shadows
Ghosting is three layers at f-1.6/-3.2/-4.8 with falling weights, giving a continuous smear (camera constants, glide curve and drop timing unchanged)
The white tiles now hold restrained mini widgets (sprint progress, due-this-week list, velocity line) with hairlines and two-layer shadows
The right page gets a hairline edge and a left drop shadow; screen-space depth fog on the left plus grain; exported STEEP_TILT_GLIDE_DURATION=120
